points.why: It says the model was checked only against successes and that the co-designer's review isn't independent, and it gives concrete counter-practices. It doesn't frame this as normal judgment rather than a failing.
It says a 2% match is expected if parameters were tuned and recommends a blind holdout, but it never recommends recording which parameters were tuned.
It recommends writing down in advance what would prove the model wrong, with a concrete churn threshold. It also asks someone outside the model and tier design to review each causal link.
It recommends sensitivity swings on elasticity and churn response tied to the decision. It also suggests replacing 'validated' with a statement of which assumptions remain to be tested in a pilot.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly says the three matches are not validation.
